decision.reason: Change 0 fixes daemon-ctl.sh's unmanaged Darwin update route; test 0 exercises the CLI route and signed-bridge boundary.
Change 1 removes VS Code's update pre-emption. Test 1 asserts the controller routing; test 0 covers the VS Code leg in the cross-client matrix.
Changes 2–5 remove JetBrains' legacy update routing and delegate to daemon-ctl.sh. Test 2 verifies the JetBrains lifecycle route; test 0 covers the JetBrains leg in the cross-client matrix.
Change 7 rewrites the VS Code controller test for the corrected update routing; test 1 is its required evidence.
Changes 6 and 8 update JetBrains freshness and lifecycle test coverage for the routing change and its compatibility; test 2 is the required JetBrains routing evidence.
Change 9 rewrites the cross-client integration route matrix; test 0 is its required evidence and also covers the three implementation paths.
